source: Kukreja et al. (2015), distributed by the CleaveNet data release
units: Released continuous Z-scores, with no additional label normalization
test_filter: CleaveNet retained 2901 of 3717 test peptides after excluding Levenshtein distance <3 to its original 14866-peptide training pool
validation_split: The original training pool is partitioned into 13666 training and 1200 validation sequences; connected components at Hamming distance <=2 are kept together
condition_rounding: Generator conditions only: round labels to 0.1 using NumPy ties-to-even rounding in float64
